## Description {#details}

C++ header file with the inline implementations for the µOS++ lists methods.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/inlines-h">inlines.h</Link></code> header provides the C++ inline implementations for the <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> classes.

Class definitions are located in <Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-h">lists.h</Link>. Inline methods are separated into this file to improve project structure and maintainability.
